name: FC-1608G1-520
title: FC-1608G1-520 chip LED, 1.6 × 0.8 mm, 520 nm peak
summary: A single surface-mount light-emitting diode in a 1.6 mm by 0.8 mm body, 0.60 mm tall. At 5 mA it emits around a 520 nm peak (dominant 520 to 538 nm) with 130 to 380 mcd of luminous intensity over a 140° viewing angle. It takes up to 20 mA continuous and 5 V of reverse bias, and is supplied 4000 to a length of 8 mm carrier tape.
key_figures: 2.3 V min, 3.0 V typ, 3.6 V max at IF = 5 mA
520 to 538 nm, 527 nm typ at IF = 5 mA
130 to 380 mcd, 260 mcd typ at IF = 5 mA
